candidates.license: Apache-2.0 in pinned upstream source tree; checkpoint is distributed in that repository, but still requires product legal review before redistribution.
candidates.class_contract: No native class labels; a genuine TASK007 box would be the prompt and retains the class provenance.
candidates.offline_android_path: Pinned upstream ViT-T checkpoint exported locally to two hashed ONNX artifacts and executed through the debug-only ONNX Runtime Android runner on a physical Realme RMX3780.
candidates.qualification_scope: Real TASK007 box-prompted instance masks on rights-cleared public car and motorcycle images, using iris-image-coordinate-v2. This is not damage classification or production-renderer approval.
limitations: Bicycle, bus and truck have not been qualified with genuine evaluation images on the device.
The cropped-car evaluation failed because TASK007 classified the target as bus; the failure remains recorded and no mask was fabricated.
Visual overlay review was performed, but no pixel-level ground-truth mask dataset was used.
The measured peak process PSS is high and model-session lifecycle/batching must be addressed before production promotion.
Checkpoint redistribution and product legal review remain required before release packaging.

candidates.license: Documentation/code examples Apache-2.0; exact model terms remain model-specific.
candidates.class_contract: Bundled models are person-part or generic semantic models and do not provide required per-vehicle instances.
candidates.offline_android_path: MediaPipe Image Segmenter supports Android, but its documented bundled models do not meet the IRIS instance contract.
blockers: Semantic/category masks cannot separate multiple same-class vehicle instances.

candidates.class_contract: COCO masks include bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus and truck instances.
candidates.offline_android_path: No qualified IRIS Android execution artifact; official checkpoint is approximately 169.84 MB before runtime overhead.
blockers: No practical governed RMX3780 runtime path at the documented size/compute cost.
